'''Dijon Football Côte d'Or''' ({{IPA|fr|diʒɔ̃ futbol kot dɔʁ}}; {{lit|Dijon Football Gold Coast}}), commonly referred to as '''Dijon FCO,''' '''Dijon''' or simply as '''DFCO''', is a French [[Football in France|football]] club based in [[Dijon]]. The club was founded in 1998 as a result of a merger between two local clubs in the city, and competed in [[Ligue 2]] after suffering relegation from [[Ligue 1]] in the 2011–12 season. The club earned promotion back to Ligue 1 at the end of the [[2015–16 Ligue 2|2015–16]] season, remained for five seasons before two relegations in three years saw the club relegated out of the professional leagues at the end of the 2022–23 season. The club's president is Olivier Delcourt. Dijon plays its home matches at the [[Stade Gaston Gérard]]."}}
